description: Single-turn factual question; small models tend to pad or hedge.
rubric: Correct core fact, no padding, no invented specifics.

turns.user: What is the difference between cholera and typhoid in terms of transmission and the first-line treatment approach in a field setting?
turns.expect: Both faecal-oral; cholera = rehydration first (ORS/IV), antibiotics adjunct; typhoid = antibiotics essential. Should not invent dosages.
